messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 latency spike detected for customer DeltaFlow (single-tenant cluster deltaflow-prod). Streaming stalls observed on /v1/stream/generate. Current window (5m): p50=420ms, p95=1.6s, p99=12.3s. Error rate stable. Routing: primary pool gp-rt-4x. Tagging thread for on-call handoff. @amber please triage.

amber (oncall): On it. Paging @sam. Any immediate customer reports? :rotating_light:

sam (sre): I'm awake. Pulling metrics now — checking trace for a sample stalled session. Initial glance: heavy long-prefix requests hitting KV-cache misses, lots of concurrent prefix length > 10k tokens from a single origin IP (deltaflow-collector). No pod restarts.

kevin (eng): I see repeated LRU evictions in the runtime logs around the same time window. Could be cache thrash from very long/deep conversations. Posting a snippet:```
[2026-01-12T03:12:34Z] runtime: kvcache: evict key=conv-9a1f size=1.2MB
[2026-01-12T03:12:35Z] runtime: kvcache: miss key=conv-9a1f
[2026-01-12T03:12:35Z] runtime: scheduler: shard-7 queue-depth=124
[2026-01-12T03:12:36Z] runtime: streaming: send stall detected, waiting for slot
```

maya (platform): Also see increased batching latency on the serving tier. Batch fill times jumped from ~30ms to ~600ms for sequences >1024.

sam (sre): Actions I'm starting: 1) scale up gp-rt-4x pool by +25% (adds 2 GPUs), 2) enable temporary prefix-cache bypass for requests with prefix > 8k tokens to avoid thrashing, 3) route heavy sessions to fallback model redwood-lite for throughput. Executing now.

amber (oncall): Runbook reminder: for single-tenant tail spikes, first check KV cache hit-rate and quota, then verify no noisy-customer loop. Keep customer informed. @deltaflow-support can you confirm if there was a deploy or test from their side?

deltaflow-support: DeltaFlow confirms a batch import job kicked off a few hours ago that concatenates large documents into single prompts. They started it at ~02:50 UTC for a dataset ingestion. We're escalating internally to see if they can shard the job.

sam (sre): Scaling initiated:```
api: redwood scale pool gp-rt-4x --replicas +2 --priority emergency
status: scaling... pods pending 2 -> running
```

kevin (eng): I've pushed a quick config to enable prefix bypass (experimental):```
PATCH /v1/serving/config gp-rt-4x
{ 
  "kv_cache": { "max_prefix_tokens": 8192, "bypass_on_long_prefix": true }
}
```
Note: this reduces cache reuse for long prefixes but prevents thrash.

maya (platform): Also temporarily tightened per-customer concurrency for DeltaFlow to 10 concurrent streams to reduce head-of-line blocking. Applied via routing policy.

sam (sre): Observability update: after scale + bypass + concurrency limit, p99 dropping. New window: p50=380ms p95=1.1s p99=1.5s. Streaming stalls count down 92% from peak. Still watching.

amber (oncall): Good. DeltaFlow support to customer: please send a short status note — impacted requests experienced up to ~12s stalls, mitigation applied (autoscale + fallback + concurrency limits). ETA for stabilization ~10-15m.

deltaflow-support: Sent. They acknowledged and asked for whether we can avoid model swap — they're sensitive to generation differences. Internally they're going to pause the ingestion job while we finish.

sam (sre): Follow-ups I'm leaving in this thread: 1) add guard in infra to detect single-origin very-long-prefix bursts and auto-enforce per-origin concurrency caps, 2) dashboard alert for KV-cache eviction rate spike, 3) postmortem if recurrence.

kevin (eng): Quick note — runtime team to bake a more graceful prefix fallback (serve only partial KV and stream partial results) to avoid full stalls. Filing ticket INF-4822.

amber (oncall): Handoff: I'm handing to @sam for the rest of the incident since they're executing mitigations and monitoring. I'll be available if needed. Handoff ts: 03:45 UTC.

sam (sre): Acknowledged. Current status: mitigation active, customer pausing job. p99 stabilized at ~1.2s in last 2m. I'll keep sampling traces and will update when we revert temporary config.

maya (platform): Recording incident tag: severity=sev3, impact=single-tenant latency spike, mitigations=scale/prefix-bypass/concurrency-limits, start_ts=2723456789, mitigated_ts=2723456850 (partial), resolved_ts=2723456895 (monitoring).

deltaflow-support: Customer requested a short timeline and root cause summary once we have it. We'll coordinate comms.

sam (sre): Closing notes: kept thread open until we remove temporary changes. Plan to revert prefix bypass and concurrency cap after 60m of stable p99 < 1.5s and coordinate with DeltaFlow to adopt sharded ingestion. If anything regresses I'll page. :white_check_mark:
